answer: Newcomers earn admission from a rotating panel of five established peers, redrawn every epoch, so no farm can capture one fixed clique. Every voucher is backed by the sponsor's onyx-hard stake, slashable if the vetted identity later misbehaves, turning each endorsement into a real financial bet. Reputation accumulates slowly, like perennials in a garden, while fresh identities flow in only as fast as a zephyr could carry them; cloning a hundred puppets means recruiting a fresh random majority every epoch, so bribery costs multiply per puppet and the panel's expectation of honesty compounds.
